newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE BAT FIRST AGAINST BOLAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE BAT FIRST AGAINST BOLAND.

text.p: Free State won the toss and decided to bat first in their four day Supersport Series match against Boland in Paarl on Friday.
Boland - Lloyd Ferreira, Andrew Wessels, Wayne Truter, Kenny Jackson, Adrian Kuiper (captain), Bryan Baguley, Andrew Wylie, Matthys Brink, Cris-Jan Vorster, Henry Williams, James Albanie.
Free State - Deon Jordaan, Gerhardus Liebenberg, Boeta Dippenaar, Louis Wilkinson (captain), Kosie Venter, Hansie Cronje, Nicky Boje, Herman Bakkes, Philip Radley, Nico Pretorius, Sarel Cilliers.
